prompt:
You are a senior financial analyst on the Healthcare Services team at a global investment bank. The Head of Equity Research has asked you to prepare a quarterly variance analysis for UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (UNH) to support an upcoming earnings preview note. The analysis will be presented to the institutional sales desk and used to frame discussion points with clients ahead of the Q1 2026 results.

Materials provided:
- UnitedHealth Group Incorporated quarterly and annual financial data extracted from SEC EDGAR XBRL filings, covering Q1 2026, FY 2025, Q3 2025, and Q2 2025. The data includes revenue, cost of goods and services sold, operating income, net income, total assets, total liabilities, stockholders' equity, cash and cash equivalents, diluted EPS, and selling/general/administrative expenses. Note that the source data contains both quarterly and cumulative (year-to-date) figures for the same periods; you must identify and use the correct standalone quarterly values.

Task requirements:
1. Create an Excel workbook with four tabs: 'Inputs', 'Income Statement Variance', 'Balance Sheet Variance', and 'Key Ratios'.
2. On the 'Inputs' sheet, list all raw financial data points for each quarter (Q1 2026, Q3 2025 standalone, Q3 2025 YTD, Q2 2025) and FY 2025 full year, clearly labeling line items and periods. Identify and label which Q3 2025 values are standalone quarterly versus cumulative YTD.
3. On the 'Income Statement Variance' sheet, build a table comparing Q1 2026 to Q3 2025 (standalone) for: Revenue, Cost of Goods and Services Sold, Operating Income, Net Income, Diluted EPS, and SG&A Expense. Calculate the absolute dollar change and percentage change (Q1 2026 vs Q3 2025) for each line item.
4. On the 'Balance Sheet Variance' sheet, build a table comparing Q1 2026 to FY 2025 for: Total Assets, Total Liabilities, Stockholders' Equity, and Cash and Cash Equivalents. Calculate the absolute dollar change and percentage change. For Stockholders' Equity, note that recent quarterly data is not available in the source and use the FY 2014 value of $32,454M as a historical reference point with an appropriate footnote.
5. On the 'Key Ratios' sheet, calculate for Q1 2026 and Q3 2025 (standalone): Operating Margin (Operating Income / Revenue), Net Margin (Net Income / Revenue), Cost-to-Revenue Ratio (COGS / Revenue), and SG&A-to-Revenue Ratio (SG&A / Revenue). Calculate the change in basis points between periods for each ratio.
6. All percentage changes must be calculated as (New Period - Old Period) / Old Period. All margin calculations must use the exact figures from the source. Format percentages as percentages and dollar amounts in billions with one decimal place.

Deliverable specification:
- Output a single Excel workbook (.xlsx) with the four sheets described above.
- Use clear headers, bold formatting for section titles and total lines, and consistent number formatting throughout.
- The Inputs sheet should serve as the single source of truth for all calculations.
